verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's security docs confirm that it sends webhooks (referencing a 'Honeybadger-Token' header for 'web hooks') implying event-driven webhook delivery exists, but there is no dedicated documentation on how to configure or subscribe to specific event types via webhooks. Missing for 10: dedicated webhook subscription/configuration docs, list of subscribable event types, and any AI-native or agent-specific webhook consumption guidance.
